chapter: A Warning From the Wrathful Fish!
act_title: A Warning From the Wrathful Fish!

quests.title: A Warning From the Wrathful Fish!

dialogue.t: {NICKNAME}, Paimon, I have some wonderful news. Everything's finally in place!
Operation Aggro-Fish De-Escalation has been a huge success!
Once the divers have cleared away all the underwater debris and our patients are a bit more relaxed, we'll be able to return them back to the wild.

dialogue.sit: Thanks so much for all your hard work.

dialogue.t: Hehe, you've been working just as hard as us, Sigewinne.
I've written an incident report and submitted it to the Palais Mermonia. A specialist in this field should be drafting relevant regulations and will notify the appropriate agencies soon...
I've also heard that some reporters, and at least one director, have shown great interest in this matter.
Who knows, maybe we'll even get to see a film about the importance of protecting aquatic environments one day?
That would be awesome! You can talk to people all you want, but there'll always be careless or stubborn folks who simply won't listen.
They need to see something really scary... Make them think that if the environment gets completely ruined, the fish will... mutate into giant, invincible monsters and destroy everything!
Give everyone who throws junk in the sea the scariest, most terrifying nightmares. That'll teach 'em to respect nature!

quests.description: Sigewinne seems to have something to tell us…
